caption: The drawing features a single urn-shaped object centered within a large rectangular border. The urn is rendered in grayscale pencil, showing shading and fine line detail. Its body is wide and rounded, tapering toward the bottom, and it sits on a circular foot with a slightly flared base. There is a decorative band running horizontally around the widest part of the urn, and a pattern is also present near the base. Below the main drawing, there is a smaller schematic or technical boxed drawing of the same urn displaying its profile with dimensions marked: the width labeled as 2¾, the height as 2¼, and the foot width as 1⅜. The scale is indicated as 1 inch equals 1 foot. The name "Meyers" is inscribed near the bottom of the main rectangle. The background is an off-white or beige color, with the drawings and text in gray pencil or ink.
title: Pewter Bowl
